candidates.title: Selling-holder legal-activation overhang validation
candidates.hypothesis: The acceptance-time selling-holder lead remains positive when the decision clock is moved without retuning to the later of the official SEC EFFECT XML clock and the first 424B3/424B4 acceptance clock when both exist, because legally activated resale supply should underperform equal-notional SPY over the following ten sessions if the measured effect is genuine rather than an acceptance-date artifact.

provenance.baseline_policy: Equal-notional long SPY over each frozen activation interval; zero pair return is the hurdle.
provenance.price_clock: Both legs enter at the first regular-session open strictly after activation_at and exit at the tenth session close.

independent_evidence.decision_exclusions: No outcome, parser alternative, amount threshold, or form reslice enters selection.
The clock linkage and 83-row roster were frozen before any post-activation price access.
Current reference metadata and bars not completed by activation_at are excluded.

expectation_gap.gap_definition: Acceptance-time replay is positive but acceptance is not legal resale activation. Exact EFFECT and final-prospectus clocks provide an independent execution-time falsifier without changing the mechanism, cost, hedge, hold, or eligibility rules.

affected_tickers: 67 unique liquid active common stocks in the frozen 83-row activation roster
transmission.catalyst: The later exact clock of official EFFECT and first 424B3/424B4 when both exist; the sole exact activation evidence otherwise.
transmission.expected_direction: Event stock underperforms equal-notional SPY from activation next open through H10.
transmission.half_life: First regular-session open strictly after activation through the tenth session close.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: Registration effectiveness is not a standardized trade feed, final prospectus timing can differ from acceptance, borrow is uncertain, and file-number linkage plus historical identity are operationally noisy.
candidates.falsifier: Reject unless the roster remains exactly 83 rows with 31/23/29 across old_thin/mid_weak/late_strong, every row executes, at least 20 rows remain in each window, aggregate and at least two windows are strictly positive after 90bp pair cost plus 20% annualized borrow for 10/252 years, aggregate remains positive after 180bp pair cost, the overlapping-hold cluster bootstrap 90% lower bound is positive, max single-ticker positive contribution is at most 40%, top-five at most 60%, and absolute contribution HHI at most 0.25. Missing rows invalidate rather than resize the sample.

baseline.policy: Equal-notional long SPY over each frozen activation interval; zero market-hedged pair return.

treatment.policy: Short the event stock and buy equal-notional SPY at activation next open, close both at H10, apply the unchanged 90bp base pair cost plus 20% annualized borrow and 180bp cost stress.

candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Zero-return cash on the equal-dollar market-hedged pair.

execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: 20% annualized research borrow assumption; paper/live blocked until broker locate is proven at decision time.
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: Fixed $2,000 per leg, at most two rows on one activation entry date; no capital allocated.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: 90bp total pair round-trip cost plus 20% annualized borrow for 10/252; stress doubles pair cost to 180bp.
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: Short active common stock plus equal-notional long SPY.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Latest 20 completed sessions known at activation require median dollar volume at least $1,000,000 and last close at least $3.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Activation_at is the later exact EFFECT and final-prospectus clock when both exist; entry is the first regular-session open strictly afterward.

prediction.confidence_reason: The acceptance-time lead was broad and large, but this independent clock moves many entries later and directly tests whether the effect survives legal activation rather than anticipation.

candidates.reopen_condition: If rejected, do not change form, parser, clock-combination, amount, liquidity, cooldown, cost, borrow, hold, hedge, or sample. Reopen only with verified actual shares sold, true takedown dates, historical broker locate, immutable identity vintages, or materially new settled forward rows.
candidates.next_machine_action: Run outcome-blind D0-D3 against history including exp-20260824-003 and reserve one observed-only activation-clock validation only if all gates pass.
